vocabulary.meaning: work given by teachers to do at home
to not be at or to not have something

grammar_tips.title: Using 'because' for reasons
grammar_tips.explanation: Put 'because' before the reason. Example: I am late because it is raining.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'so' for results
grammar_tips.explanation: Put 'so' before the result. Example: It is raining, so I am late.

example_sentences.sentence: I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast.
It is raining, so I took my umbrella.
He is tired because he worked all day.
She missed the bus, so she was late.

vocabulary.question: Which word means 'to give a reason'?
